content: 1. Matthews GA (2001) discussed the dermal exposure of hands to pesticides in the book Toxicology of Skin, edited by Maibach HI, published by Taylor and Francis in Philadelphia, USA, pages 179–182. 2. Meek ME et al. (2011) presented a framework by WHO/IPCS for risk assessment of combined exposure to multiple chemicals in the journal Regulatory Toxicology and Pharmacology, volume 60, pages S1–S14. 3. Mineau P et al. (1994) critiqued the avian 5-day dietary test (LC50) as a basis for avian risk assessment in a technical report published by the Canadian Wildlife Service, Ottawa (Technical Report Series 215). 4. Mukhtari M (2009) provided guidelines for dengue vector control during outbreaks and emergencies, accessible via a publication on national guidelines for dengue vector control in Pakistan. 5. Najera JA and Zaim M (2002) outlined decision-making criteria and procedures for judicious use of insecticides in malaria vector control, accessible in a WHO document. 6. Nantel G (1999) discussed the role of carbohydrates in human nutrition in the publication Food, Nutrition, and Agriculture, issue 24. 7. The Nordic Council of Ministers (2007) detailed probabilistic exposure assessment methods in chemical safety assessments under the REACH framework. 8. OECD (2011) provided guidelines for the testing of chemicals, including subsequent revisions. 9. PSD (2007) published a user’s guide for the UK Predictive Operator Exposure Model (POEM). 10. Solecki R et al. (2005) provided guidance on setting acute reference doses (ARfD) for pesticides in the journal Food and Chemical Toxicology, volume 43, pages 1569–1593. 11. SCHER (2011) addressed the toxicity and assessment of chemical mixtures in a report by the Scientific Committee on Health and Environmental Risks. 12. Teske ME et al. (2002) developed AgDRIFT, a model for estimating near-field spray drift from aerial applications, published in Environmental Toxicology and Chemistry, volume 21, pages 659–671. 13. The United Nations (2015) published the 6th edition of the Globally Harmonized System of Classification and Labelling of Chemicals. 14. USAID (2006) conducted a programmatic environmental assessment for insecticide-treated materials in sub-Saharan Africa. 15. USEPA (2008) released the Child-Specific Exposure Factors Handbook (final report). 16. USEPA (2010) finalized test guidelines for pesticides and toxic substances. 17. Vermeire T et al. (1999) discussed assessment factors for human health risk assessment in the journal Critical Reviews in Toxicology, volume 29, pages 439–490. 18. WHO (1990) provided a document on assessing human health risks of chemicals, focusing on deriving guidance values for health-based exposure limits. 19. WHO (1994) outlined principles for assessing risks to human health from exposure to chemicals. 20. WHO (1999) published principles for the assessment of risks to human health from chemical exposure. 21. WHO (2003) released a practitioner’s guide on space spray application of insecticides for vector and public health pest control. 22. WHO (2005a) provided guidance on chemical-specific adjustment factors for interspecies differences and human variability in dose/concentration-response assessment. 23. WHO (2005b) outlined principles for characterizing and applying human exposure models. 24. WHO (2006) published specification guidelines for equipment used in vector control. 25. WHO (2008) released a guidance document on characterizing and communicating uncertainty in exposure assessment. 26. WHO (2009a) provided guidelines for efficacy testing of insecticides for indoor and outdoor ground-applied space spray applications. 27. WHO (2009b) discussed principles for modeling dose-response relationships for chemical risk assessment. 28. WHO (2009d) outlined principles and methods for the risk assessment of chemicals in food. 29. WHO (2010) published a document on risk assessment methodologies. 30. WHO (2011) released comprehensive guidelines for the prevention and control of dengue and dengue hemorrhagic fever. 31. WHO (2018a) published the second edition of specification guidelines for vector control equipment. 32. WHO (2018b) released the second edition of a generic risk assessment model for insecticide-treated nets.
